description: Create a workflow (multi-step automation) that runs checks without anyone asking. Triggers: manual, schedule (cron), webhook, or vercel_event / github_event / cursor_event / linear_event / slack_event / figma_event so checklists re-run on deploys, pull requests, or design updates. Add steps with add_workflow_step (each one is wired to the step before it). A workflow with any trigger but manual starts runs on its own, so a connection without the mcp:run scope creates it paused; activate it with toggle_workflow over a connection holding mcp:run, or from the dashboard.

description.description: What the automation is for. Omit to leave it blank.

name.description: Display name, 1 to 200 characters, e.g. "Checkout smoke test on deploy".

project_id.description: Project UUID, from list_projects, to file the workflow under. Omit for a workspace-level workflow.

trigger_config.description: For schedule triggers include { cron, timezone } (timezone is an IANA name; when omitted it falls back to your get_me timezone, then UTC). For figma_event include { events: ["FILE_UPDATE" | "FILE_COMMENT" | "FILE_VERSION_UPDATE" | "LIBRARY_PUBLISH"], file_key }; file_key is required and at most 3 events per workflow (events are received per file, through a Figma connection in the workspace with edit access to it, and Figma allows 3 webhooks per file); when events includes LIBRARY_PUBLISH you may narrow it with library_item_types (subset of ["components","styles","variables"]) and library_change_kinds (subset of ["created","modified","deleted"]) to fire only when matching design-system changes are published.

trigger_type.description: What starts a run: manual (only run_workflow), schedule (cron), webhook (a signing secret is generated and shown only in the dashboard), or a provider event (vercel_event, github_event, cursor_event, linear_event, slack_event, figma_event). Defaults to manual.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: create_workflow

is_active.description: False when the workflow was created paused, because it would start runs on its own and this connection does not hold mcp:run.

workflow_id.description: The new workflow UUID; pass it to add_workflow_step next.

title: Create workflow
